purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: The official Wrocław city GIS parcel layer is a public polygon feature service. A bounded point query at the unchanged WUP locator returned one polygon (OBJECTID 1130; ID_SWDE 026401_1.0001.1449), and point-in-ring evaluation confirmed the locator lies inside it. One full Polygon with only these safe identifiers and geometry was retained. This is a point sample, not a citywide completeness or topology claim.
